Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Namma Yatri's payment processing loader - a yellow arc spinner rotates at center while a white metro train loops around it on a curved track, over "Payment Processing" copy.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark "Payment Details" screen: a yellow arc spinner centered, a metro train illustration traveling a curved dashed track that sweeps around the spinner, "Payment Processing" with supporting copy below.

## Motion spec
Pattern: looping spinner with orbiting train.
- Spinner: the yellow arc rotates continuously (one revolution per 1s, linear).
- Train: the train travels the curved track (an arc path passing under and around the spinner) in a 2.4s loop - entering from the left edge, banking along the curve with its rotation matched to the path tangent, and exiting right; a faint dashed rail follows the same curve.
- Entry: the whole loader fades in (250ms) when processing starts.
- The copy is static; all motion is the spinner and train.

## Calibration
- The train's angle follows the track tangent - it visibly banks through the curve.
- Train and spinner loops are independent periods (2.4s vs 1s), so the composition never repeats exactly.

## Reduced motion
Spinner only; the train is parked on the track.

## Don't miss
- The train passes in front of the spinner at the bottom of the curve and behind at the top.
- The dashed rail is part of the illustration, not a progress bar.
